item.title: Retail Jeweller Festival unveils full content programme for March 2026 event
item.description: Retail Jeweller Retail Jeweller Festival unveils full content programme for March 2026 event Retail Jeweller has announced the full content programme for the 2026 Retail Jeweller Festival, taking place on 16–17 March, bringing together independent retailers, multiples, suppliers and industry leaders for two days of buying, insight, strategy and networking. item.title: Hot Diamonds to debut new stainless steel jewellery brand this summer
item.description: Retail Jeweller Hot Diamonds to debut new stainless steel jewellery brand this summer Fashion jewellery brand Hot Diamonds is set to launch a new 316L stainless steel jewellery brand, Ava & Sky, with the official debut scheduled for June 2026. item.title: Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection The collection opens with Orpheus, featuring Madagascan labradorite carved into clean, elemental squares and rectangles. Low-polished to reveal flashes of kingfisher blue and peacock turquoise, the stones are set in 18ct gold across rings, pendants and tile bracelets. The pieces have a monolithic presence, establishing… Pippa Small unveils AW26 collection Ruth Faulkner
